prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is approached, take it, check properties, move and do specific task, otherwise approach or scan area. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToDestination    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
		DO MoveToDestination
		DO SpecificTask
	END
